def time_to_minutes(time_str):
    parts = time_str.split(':')
    hour = int(parts[0])
    minute = int(parts[1])
    return (hour - 9) * 60 + minute

def minutes_to_time(minutes):
    total_minutes = minutes
    hour = total_minutes // 60 + 9
    minute = total_minutes % 60
    return f"{hour}:{minute:02d}"

def main():

        'Mission District': {'The Castro': 7, 'Nob Hill': 12, 'Presidio': 25, 'Marina District': 19, 'Pacific Heights': 16, 'Golden Gate Park': 17, 'Chinatown': 16, 'Richmond District': 20},

        'Presidio': {'Mission District': 26, 'The Castro': 21, 'Nob Hill': 18, 'Marina District': 11, 'Pacific Heights': 11, 'Golden Gate Park': 12, 'Chinatown': 21, 'Richmond District': 7},

        'Richmond District': {'Mission District': 20, 'The Castro': 16, 'Nob Hill': 17, 'Presidio': 7, 'Marina District': 9, 'Pacific Heights': 10, 'Golden Gate Park': 9, 'Chinatown': 20}
    }
    
    friends = [
        {'name': 'Lisa', 'location': 'The Castro', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('19:15'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('21:15'), 'duration': 120},
        {'name': 'Daniel', 'location': 'Nob Hill', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('8:15'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('11:00'), 'duration': 15},
        {'name': 'Elizabeth', 'location': 'Presidio', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('21:15'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('22:15'), 'duration': 45},
        {'name': 'Steven', 'location': 'Marina District', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('16:30'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('20:45'), 'duration': 90},
        {'name': 'Timothy', 'location': 'Pacific Heights', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('12:00'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('18:00'), 'duration': 90},
        {'name': 'Ashley', 'location': 'Golden Gate Park', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('20:45'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('21:45'), 'duration': 60},
        {'name': 'Kevin', 'location': 'Chinatown', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('12:00'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('19:00'), 'duration': 30},
        {'name': 'Betty', 'location': 'Richmond District', 'start_avail': time_to_minutes('13:15'), 'end_avail': time_to_minutes('15:45'), 'duration': 30}
    ]
    
    n = len(friends)
    solver = None
    model = None
    max_meetings = 0
    
    for k in range(n, 0, -1):
        s = Solver()
        do_meet = [Bool(f"do_meet_{i}") for i in range(n)]
        start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
        
        # Constraint: exactly k meetings

        for i in range(n):

            loc = friend['location']

            s.add(Implies(do_meet[i], start[i] >= travel_from_mission))
            s.add(Implies(do_meet[i], start[i] >= friend['start_avail']))
            s.add(Implies(do_meet[i], start[i] + friend['duration'] <= friend['end_avail']))
            
            for j in range(i+1, n):
                if i != j:
                    loc_i = friends[i]['location']
                    loc_j = friends[j]['location']
                    travel_ij = travel_times[loc_i][loc_j]
                    travel_ji = travel_times[loc_j][loc_i]
                    s.add(Implies(And(do_meet[i], do_meet[j]),
                                  Or(start[i] + friends[i]['duration'] + travel_ij <= start[j],
                                     start[j] + friends[j]['duration'] + travel_ji <= start[i])))
        
        if s.check() == sat:
            model = s.model()
            max_meetings = k
            break
    
    itinerary = []
    if model is not None:
        meeting_list = []
        for i in range(n):
            if is_true(model.eval(do_meet[i])):

                    'location': friend['location'],

                    'end': start_val + friend['duration']

        meeting_list.sort(key=lambda x: x['start'])

                'person': meet['name'],
                'start_time': minutes_to_time(meet['start']),
                'end_time': minutes_to_time(meet['end'])
            })
    
    result = {
        "itinerary": itinerary
    }
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

    main()
